assumptions: Equivalent seeded orders and starting inventory/balances
Server-side route model at 5 m/s; no avatar navigation or traffic
One sequential worker; four authorized actions per delivery

limitations: This is a local campus simulation, not an independently validated real-world result.
Simulation units have no naira conversion or redemption value. Recognition units are separate, local and unfunded.
The deterministic agent models logistics on the server; it is not a physically navigating character.
No official WorkStream acceptance, Flow Research points or external rewards.
One server writer; retain the configured data volume and backups. Guest records require the same session token.
